# DeNet Storage Desktop

> Client-side encrypted, private cloud storage application for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Overview
DeNet Storage Desktop is a cross-platform desktop application for decentralized, zero-knowledge cloud storage powered by the DeNet protocol (operating since 2017). The network spans 7.5M+ participants with 2,000+ independent storage nodes (Datakeepers) across 194 countries.

## Architecture & Storage Model
1. Splitting into Parts: Files are sliced locally into 1 MB parts.
2. Client-Side Encryption: Each part is encrypted with AES-256 before transmission. Only the user holds the keys.
3. Reed-Solomon Erasure Coding: Encrypted parts are coded into redundant 1 MB shards using Reed-Solomon parity.
4. Decentralized Distribution: Shards are uploaded across independent Datakeeper nodes. No single node holds a full file or decryption keys.
5. Autoreplication: The network automatically detects unreachable nodes and replicates missing shards onto active nodes.
6. Billing: Pay-as-you-go balance model based on exact space stored over time with a minimum baseline of 100 GB (no mandatory monthly subscription tiers).

## Supported Platforms
- Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit x86_64) - installer package: .exe
- macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) - installer package: .dmg
- Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch) - packages: .AppImage, .deb, .rpm
